newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak FinMin 5-wk T-bill yield hits 16.048 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovak FinMin 5-wk T-bill yield hits 16.048 pct.

text.p: Average yield in a Slovak Finance Ministry auction of five-week treasury bills on Wednesday hit 16.048 percent, the central bank (NBS) said in statement.
The ministry accepted bids worth 2.420 billion crowns ($71.9 million), of which one billion crowns went directly to NBS portfolio.
It was the first auction of five week T-bills this year.
In the last auction of state paper with a similar maturity, four-week T-bills on May 7, average yield was 14.21 percent.
The ministry does not set an amount on offer at state securities auctions or set a minimum or maximum limit price on bids.

It uses T-bills and state bonds as the main tools to cover the state budget deficit, which widened to 7.177 billion crowns in the January-May period of 1997 from a shortfall of 4.692 billion crowns for the first four months of 1997.
